"''Aberrant heat signature. Port-side thruster.|Captain Elk and the pit crew member|audio=Elk-Thermal.flac|}} A light-skinned [[human]] with [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] served as a '''member''' of the pit crew on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of a [[Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser|''Cantwell''-class Arrestor Cruiser]] [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by [[Captain]] [[Elk]] as part of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Segra-Milo Imperial patrol]]. While patrolling near the [[planet]]{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} {{AD|Disney+}} [[Segra Milo]] in [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|111}} the [[cruiser]] encountered a [[Luthen Rael's Fondor Haulcraft|Fondor Haulcraft]], which Elk had the crew member hold in a [[tractor beam]] while its [[Transponder code|transponder ID]] was checked. While it was held, the [[V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft|haulcraft's]] owner, the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Luthen Rael]], activated one of its port-side [[Engine|thrusters]] and claimed it was [[Temperature|overheating]]. Elk had the pit crew member check the haulcraft's thermals, with the crew member responding that there was an aberrant heat signature on the port-side thruster. Based on this, Elk ordered that a boarding party be prepared, but ultimately Rael escaped from the Imperials. The pit crew member wore a black [[Imperial military uniforms|uniform]] with a [[Imperial kepi|cap]] that included an [[officer's disk]]. ==Behind the scenes== The pit crew member, credited only as "Pit #2" was portrayed by [[Hebe Beardsall]] in the television show ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', appearing in the [[Andor Season 1|first season's]] eleventh episode, "[[Daughter of Ferrix]]," which aired on [[November 16]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like.
